svg.title: Shinkansen Ticket Decision Tree: JR Pass, EX Hayatoku 21, smartEX, or Station Ticket Machine
svg.desc: Three questions. Question 1: Do your Shinkansen fares within 7 days total more than 50,000 yen? If yes, buy a 7-day Ordinary Car JR Pass at 50,000 yen (from October 1, 2026, 53,000 yen via travel agencies while the official online site stays at 50,000 yen for now); riding Nozomi requires a per-leg supplement, such as 4,960 yen for Tokyo–Shin-Osaka. If no, go to Question 2: Are you booking at least 21 days ahead with fixed dates and trains? If yes, buy EX Hayatoku 21—Tokyo–Shin-Osaka 12,980 yen, Tokyo–Kyoto 12,430 yen, Tokyo–Hakata 17,920 yen; closes at 11:30 PM 21 days prior, no train changes allowed, 320-yen refund fee. If no, go to Question 3: Do you want to book online before arriving in Japan and tap an IC card or scan a QR ticket at the gate? If yes, use standard smartEX fares—Tokyo–Shin-Osaka 14,520 yen, Tokyo–Kyoto 13,970 yen, Tokyo–Nagoya 11,100 yen; unlimited free train changes before departure, 320-yen refund fee. If no, buy paper tickets at a station ticket machine or Midori-no-Madoguchi ticket office at standard fares with no Hayatoku discount. Notes: Baggage with combined length, width, and height up to 160 cm can be brought onboard freely; bags between 161 and 250 cm require reserving an oversized baggage seat at no extra charge (1,000-yen fee without a reservation); bags over 250 cm are not allowed onboard. During peak holiday periods, all Nozomi trains are all-reserved-seat; reserved-seat fares vary by season (-200 yen off-peak, +200 yen peak, +400 yen highest-peak), and the JR Pass does not cover Nozomi or Mizuho directly.
svg.text: How to Buy Shinkansen Tickets: 3 Questions to Pick Your Option
JR Pass, EX Hayatoku 21, smartEX, or station ticket machines (fares verified September 2026)
to tap an IC card or QR ticket?
Free changes before departure; ¥320 refund fee
English menu & seat reservations; standard fares
No Hayatoku discount; counter lines in peak seasons
Total dimensions ≤160 cm: bring onboard freely (overhead rack or at your feet)
161–250 cm: reserve an oversized baggage seat (no extra charge)
No reservation: ¥1,000 fee onboard; over 250 cm: not allowed
Golden Week, Obon, Silver Week, New Year & 4 long weekends: Nozomi all-reserved
Reserved seat pricing: off-peak −¥200, peak +¥200, highest-peak +¥400
JR Pass does not cover Nozomi or Mizuho (not even non-reserved seats)
Fares from Tokyo, adult one-way Ordinary reserved (regular season): smartEX (2025-04-01), EX Hayatoku 21 (2026-03-13), JR Pass site; Sep 2026.
Sendai/Kanazawa routes (JR East/West; Hayabusa & Kagayaki all-reserved) use eki-net; check official sites (JR East fare hike 2026-03-14).
